newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 24.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 24.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Upper-level public servants are set to receive a substantial pay increase next year in order to partially keep up with wages in the business sphere.
- The city of Budapest will support police with 250 million forints.
- The professional education fund will receive 16 to 18 billion forints worth of employers' contributions this year.
- The government plans to support potato producers who are facing losses due to massive excess stocks.
- Thursday's government meeting is expected to discuss the pension reform and a programme to support small and medium-size enterprises.
- The privatisation of Hungary's defence industry cannot be done according to general privatisation practices, Defence Ministry officials said.
